chronological_fold_design.design: Synthetic projection-equivalence preparation followed, only after separate run approval, by one chronological fresh-history regeneration over the same 36 targets.
chronological_fold_design.failure_denominator_rule: All 36 original targets remain in the ledger.
chronological_fold_design.late_race_rule: Any target not persisted before its original cutoff is a deterministic failure and cannot be regenerated as prospective evidence.
chronological_fold_design.ordering: prior-day result source time <= feature source time <= generation <= freeze persistence acknowledgement <= original candidate cutoff
chronological_fold_design.real_data_rule: No real 2026-08-02 row is read during APPROVED_TO_PREPARE.
chronological_fold_design.target_selection_rule: Projection cannot add, remove, reorder, or reprioritize a race using market or result information.

proposal_scope.data_as_of: Race identities and cutoffs remain those fixed in EXP007 and EXP008. EXP010 was registered at 2026-08-02T10:53:30+09:00 with 27 cutoffs not yet passed. Only immutable target metadata was inspected; preparation remains synthetic-only until a distinct APPROVED_TO_RUN grant.
proposal_scope.hypothesis: Creating hash-bound successor target manifests that change only experiment_id and cohort_id while preserving every race record, scheduled time, and candidate cutoff will satisfy the adapter identity contract and allow the already-fixed fresh-history pipeline to regenerate only still-on-time candidates.
in_scope: Add synthetic regression tests proving all projected records and cutoffs equal their source manifests
After separate run approval, require matched prior-result files, joined rows, history through 20260801, Top3 mass one, and WIDE mass three
Change only experiment_id and cohort_id in each projected target manifest
Create EXP010 configs that preserve the frozen bundle, probability contract, candidate policy, threshold, calibrator, and safety flags
Create one EXP010 target-manifest projection per venue with unchanged records and target-card metadata
Retain all 36 targets as candidate-ready or deterministic failure rows
Use synthetic fixtures only during APPROVED_TO_PREPARE
lineage_hash_requirements: Candidate-ready rows require source receipt, feature completion, and persistence acknowledgement before the original registered cutoff

Every output sets candidate_uses_odds false, formal_buy false, send_order false, and stake zero

The frozen inference bundle, feature schema, candidate policy, input snapshot, source manifests, and packet ledger are SHA-256 bound
proposal_scope.null_hypothesis: The successor projections alter a race identity or cutoff, fail adapter validation, accept a late target, fail the fresh-history contract, or require any model, candidate-policy, market, dashboard, or order-path change.
out_of_scope: Any Strict T-3 quote, schedule decision, scratch decision, final quote, or outcome join

primary_metric.baseline: EXP009 failed before network access because successor configs and immutable source target manifests had different experiment_id values.
primary_metric.evaluation: Projection identity, all-target completeness, fresh-history assertions, source-time validity, and probability invariants.
primary_metric.name: target_projection_and_fresh_history_contract_completeness

purge_embargo.history_cutoff: Only result history dated 2026-08-01 or earlier and received before the candidate cutoff is allowed.
purge_embargo.market_firewall: No odds, popularity, market rank, payout, current-day result, or derivative may influence the candidate.
purge_embargo.post_event_embargo: No target can be promoted after its original registered cutoff.
purge_embargo.target_selection_embargo: The three existing target manifests and all 36 race identities are immutable.

proposal_scope.racing_mechanism: The target-manifest projection changes no racing information. It only binds unchanged pre-registered race identities and cutoffs to the successor experiment identifier so that the frozen non-odds Top3-set model can consume fresh prior-day history under its existing validation contract.
